column1: # Confirmed reference fields: an EVALUATION SET, never an input to generation.
# Each row is a field that upstream implemented as a KCC reference and that our
# mechanically generated CRD emitted as a plain string. The answers exist only
# because upstream had already done the work; a genuinely new resource has no
# such answer, so nothing here can feed the generator.
# What it is for: measuring a reference heuristic's RECALL. An earlier attempt at
# name-based detection was abandoned after it produced 2,164 findings, but nobody
# could count how many real references it caught, because no list of correct
# answers existed. This is that list.
# Provenance: the 239-resource replication run on branch greenfield-healthy100,
# baseline c1df0b9326 (predates every experiment commit, so all resources there
# are hand-written upstream work). Pairs come from `crd-mcp-server score`, which
# reports each baseline reference path alongside the plain field we generated in
# its place. Target types are resolved by matching the JSON tag in upstream's Go
# source -- not by deriving a field name from the path, which left 15-22 rows
# unresolved and mis-stated several per-type counts.
# Scope: the 98 measured resources, excluding compute and networksecurity whose
# CRD generation failed and left stale files.
# kind<TAB>service<TAB>plain field we generated<TAB>reference path upstream used<TAB>target ref type
